description:
Powerful and intelligent flash cards.

Anki is a program which makes remembering things easy.
Because it's a lot more efficient than traditional study methods, you can either greatly decrease your time spent studying, or greatly increase the amount you learn.
Anyone who needs to remember things in their daily life can benefit from Anki.
Since it is content-agnostic and supports images, audio, videos and scientific markup (via LaTeX), the possibilities are endless.
What's Changed
⚠️ This update contains important security fixes. Please upgrade as soon as possible.
- Shared decks could execute arbitrary code via iframes when viewed in the editor (GHSA-j9v5-m549-cg6c). Thanks to @DePierre for the report.
- On macOS, shared decks could execute arbitrary commands via specially crafted image filenames when the "Show in Folder" editor action is used (GHSA-gfvm-4968-jp9m). Thanks to @hyperreality and @Hama1cco for the reports.
- Compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates are now disallowed. This is in response to a widespread security incident affecting most systems and web browsers. Updating Anki might not be enough. Please make sure your system is fully up to date.
Full Changelog: 26.09.3...26.09.4
